messages:
anya: Quick follow-up on the quant RFC — proposal: runtime auto-threshold that flips to higher-precision if the degradation_score exceeds X for Y requests. want to align on schema and ops fallout.
sam: +1 on auto-thresholding idea. main Q: do we compute degradation_score in runtime or rely on telemetry service? runtime has latency constraints.
lia: My $0.02: runtime should only emit a lightweight signal (ok/warn/critical). full scoring can be async in telemetry. we can use a short moving window in runtime for immediate decisions.
mike: Agreed. For emergency rollback we need a clear per-endpoint override that can be toggled without a deployment. maybe a config flag in envoy or our routing layer.
anya: Exactly — thinking of a per-endpoint tag in the quant_profile with fields: `staleness`, `signal_ttl`, `critical_threshold`. Example schema: ```json
{"version":"v2","profiles":[{"id":"fp8-agg","staleness":"72h","signal_ttl":10,"critical_threshold":0.35}]} 
```
lia: That looks fine. Two notes: 1) `signal_ttl` units = requests? seconds? pick consistent unit. 2) `critical_threshold` should be normalized to our degscore metric (0-1).
sam: Good catch. make `signal_ttl` = number of recent samples used. runtime will keep last N per shard. Also need a `min_samples` guard so we don't flip on noise.
anya: I'll add `min_samples`. Also we should expose a runtime metric `quant_profile.switch_count` for alerting.
devops-bot: deploybot: Canary deployment started for service=llm-inference, cfg=quant-autothreshold-2026-03-23
mike: Ops question — if a customer pins a model/precision, do we honor that over auto-threshold? I think yes, but we need a visible precedence table.
lia: Precedence: customer_pin > manual_route_override > auto-threshold > default_profile. document this in the profile spec.
sam: One more tradeoff: auto-upgrading precision increases cost. Should we add a budget cap at per-customer or per-endpoint level? maybe `max_extra_tokens_per_hour` or `cost_burst_limit`.
anya: Good idea. Add `cost_budget_tokens` (optional) to profile. If exceeded, fallback to default and emit an event.
lia: Ops runbook sketch: - alert when switch_count spikes - if repeated switches, escalate to oncall - manual override endpoint `/config/override?service=foo&profile=fp8-agg&lock=on` - rollback steps documented.
mike: Can we get a tiny CLI for SREs? `rictl quant override --service foo --profile fp8-agg --lock on`.
anya: I'll file a follow-up doc with the full spec and sample CLI. For now final asks: @sam add runtime hook PR, @lia update schema in infra repo, @mike draft ops playbook. I'll coordinate a 30m follow-up tomorrow.
sam: on it. will ping when I open the PR.
lia: schema PR incoming.
mike: will draft playbook and CLI stub.
anya: :thumbsup: thanks all, closing thread for now.
